items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I studied classically. Marcel Mule, when I first played the Concertino de Camera by Ibert

ctx.x: It’s obvious that the classical part of music has been a big influence on you too. I can hear it in your playing.

Oh, yeah. Well I studied classically. Marcel Mule, when I first played the Concertino de Camera by Ibert, oh yes. I performed that several times on the air but I never recorded it. I never recorded it.
